closing.summary: Big strengths are omega 3, magnesium, and protein, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin E, low protein quality, and low starch. It is good for bone health, hormone health, and immune support because magnesium gives the bone-health case something to work with, the fat section has enough useful fats for a support role, and zinc gives the immune-support side a reason to exist.
